# Open.Ed – The University of Edinburgh Open Educational Resources

> Open.Ed is the University of Edinburgh's platform for discovering, creating, and sharing UNESCO-aligned open educational resources across diverse subjects and educational levels.

Open.Ed provides free, openly licensed educational materials ranging from research-informed teaching resources to specialized collections in earth observation, health sciences, and cultural heritage. The platform supports educators, students, and organizations through guidance on OER creation, distribution, and best practices in open education.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Creative Commons Licensing

## Getting Started

- [Open.Ed – The University of Edinburgh Open Educational Resources](https://open.ed.ac.uk): Homepage for University of Edinburgh's Open Educational Resources platform
- [About – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/about): About page explaining Open.Ed's mission and alignment with UNESCO OER standards
- [Contact Us – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/contact-us): Contact page for Open.Ed OER Service and staff directory

## Learning and Training

- [Digital Skills Programme – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/digital-skills-programme): Digital Skills Programme with workshops on copyright, licensing, and OER training
- [How To Guides – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/how-to-guides): How-to guides for creating, finding, and sharing open educational resources
- [OER Channels – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/oer-channels): Guide to OER distribution channels including Media Hopper and TES Resources
- [Open Education Week 2026 – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/open-education-week-2026): Open Education Week 2026 event featuring workshops and staff training

## Research-Informed Educational Resources

- [Research Informed OERs for Primary and Secondary Level Education – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/research-informed-oers-for-primary-and-secondary-level-education): Research-informed OERs for primary and secondary school teaching materials
- [Research Informed OERs for Further Education, Higher Education, and CPD – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/research-informed-oers-for-further-education-higher-education-and-cpd): Research-informed OERs for FE, HE, and continuous professional development
- [Sustainable Development Goal OERs – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/sustainable-development-goal-oers): Collection of OERs aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals
- [Responsible AI for SMEs – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/responsible-ai-for-sme): MOOC on responsible AI governance and ethics for small and medium enterprises

## Specialized Collections

- [SatSchool: Earth Observation educational resources designed and delivered by PhD students – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/satschool-earth-observation-educational-resources-designed-and-delivered-by-phd-students): SatSchool earth observation resources by PhD students from SENSE CDT
- [HIV Informed – Scotland (IReSH) – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/hiv-informed-scotland-iresh): HIV education microsite with lived experience videos for healthcare workforce
- [The impact of painful sexual and reproductive health (SRH) procedures – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/the-impact-of-painful-sexual-and-reproductive-health-srh-procedures): Research seminar on gender pain gap by Dr Carrie Purcell and IReSH Network
- [International Women's Day OERs – Rights Justice Action – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/international-womens-day-oers-rights-justice-action): OER collection on feminist cities and women's rights featuring podcast series

## Digital Archives and Heritage Collections

- [RZSS Online Exhibition – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/rzss-online-exhibition): Digital archive of Royal Zoological Society of Scotland heritage collections
- [The Indian Primer – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/the-indian-primer): Digitized 17th-century rare book by John Eliot on Native American language
- [Dunfermline College: Dance Training of Scotland – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/dunfermline-college-dance-training-of-scotland): Digital archive of Dunfermline College's women's physical education history

## News and Updates

- [Blog – Open.Ed](https://open.ed.ac.uk/blog): Blog featuring SatSchool, earth observation, and open education initiatives
